commentary: Every walked edit was re-read at HEAD: readArchive's precedence (sync_specs.ran, specs_synced, sync.synced, a sync_specs listing capabilities) matches the order the delta spec now states; listDir refuses everything but an absent folder and is called before each folder the brief reads; readMeta, the empty-plan and missing-spec.md refusals, the archive-record ordering and the architecture trail's doc filter each read as their entries claim, and each was shown able to fail by the walk's mutations. The residual check found nothing outside the edit records. The one gap is the CLI page, which still lists the earlier set of refusals. The reading step read the 14 selected records: the pattern is restatement drift in the earliest records, written before the walks moved D-br-4 to D-br-6 to D-br-8, and file-layout words (archive record, shape, field, settings) in the newest ones.

verification.title: Archive records of earlier generations that do record their sync are refused, so four archived changes and a completed program can never be briefed
An invalid delta spec renders as a capability with no requirements instead of failing the brief
Archived changes within a stage are ordered by archive date and then by name, not in the order they were archived
Unreadable change metadata silently drops a change from its program brief
A program brief checks every doc's records on the shared architecture trail, so one bad record of another doc refuses it
Directory read failures silently become missing history
